title: ANTS KellyKapowski

convergence.desc: Convergence is determined by fitting a line to the normalized energy profile of the last N iterations (where N is specified by the window size) and determining the slope which is then compared with the convergence threshold.

gradient_step.desc: Gradient step size for the optimization.

gray_matter_prob_image.desc: In addition to the segmentation image, a gray matter probability image can be used. If no such image is supplied, one is created using the segmentation image and a variance of 1.0 mm.

max_invert_displacement_field_iters.desc: Maximum number of iterations for estimating the invertdisplacement field.

number_integration_points.desc: Number of compositions of the diffeomorphism per iteration.

segmentation_image.desc: A segmentation image must be supplied labeling the gray and white matters. Default values = 2 and 3, respectively.

smoothing_variance.desc: Defines the Gaussian smoothing of the hit and total images.

smoothing_velocity_field.desc: Defines the Gaussian smoothing of the velocity field (default = 1.5). If the b-spline smoothing option is chosen, then this defines the isotropic mesh spacing for the smoothing spline (default = 15).

thickness_prior_estimate.desc: Provides a prior constraint on the final thickness measurement in mm.

thickness_prior_image.desc: An image containing spatially varying prior thickness values.

use_bspline_smoothing.desc: Sets the option for B-spline smoothing of the velocity field.

white_matter_prob_image.desc: In addition to the segmentation image, a white matter probability image can be used. If no such image is supplied, one is created using the segmentation image and a variance of 1.0 mm.

description: Nipype Interface to ANTs' KellyKapowski, also known as DiReCT.
